name: @workbench/cli
description: Shared agentic software-development context, records, and change gates

scripts.format:check: node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check src tests "scripts/**/*.mjs" scripts/*-assets.json scripts/bootstrap-tools.json scripts/package-manager/*.json ".devcontainer/**/*.json" "examples/**/scripts/*.mjs" bin/*.mjs bin/*.cjs package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.mjs .prettierrc.json .pnpmfile.cjs
scripts.format: node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --write src tests "scripts/**/*.mjs" scripts/*-assets.json scripts/bootstrap-tools.json scripts/package-manager/*.json ".devcontainer/**/*.json" "examples/**/scripts/*.mjs" bin/*.mjs bin/*.cjs package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.mjs .prettierrc.json .pnpmfile.cjs
scripts.lint: node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --config eslint.config.mjs src tests scripts bin "examples/**/scripts/*.mjs" --max-warnings 0 .pnpmfile.cjs eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run bundle:check && pnpm run test
